summary: Dine Brands Global, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01. The filing announces a quarterly cash dividend of $0.19 per share for Q2 2026 and a new $100 million share repurchase program, supplemental to the existing program with $51 million remaining. No special situation event is reported; the dividend and buyback authorization are ordinary capital allocation activities. Routine in nature, no board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are involved. The filing provides no unusual terms or events to monitor.
